items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: I know once, I used to question Minnetta, since he played violin, whether you could really hear the violin in the band... since I try to play violin myself, in, say, a ragtime band

ctx.x: What was that? Was that for the, part of the form of it, the definite form, or did it build momentum towards the end, or?

Well, yeah, just to give more contrast, and then to make the final all-out chorus, as they called it, more effective. More effective, yeah. I know once, I used to question Minnetta, since he played violin, whether you could really hear the violin in the band, because you'd wonder, you know, since I try to play violin myself, in, say, a ragtime band, and half the time you can't hear it unless there's a microphone and amplifier there, and Minnetta said, too, you could hardly hear the violin most of the time. Maybe…
